surface.name: gully-up
surface.label: Graduation Peak: up the gully
surface.blurb: Real ground, from the Kachemak Bay 2023 lidar, below Graduation Peak: corner to corner across the patch, from 20 m in from the south-west corner to 20 m in from the north-east one (made up), 90 m of climb in 386 m (23 %), along the main gully, whose walls are 80-120 %. The same ground as "across the gullies", on the steep diagonal. There is no formula here: the straight line is the comparison.
